requirements.statement: The submitted file defines top module golden12_fifo with the public parameter and port contract.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Compilation must bind the exact module, parameter names, port names, directions, and widths.
requirements.verification_intent: Visible compile and lint check; later hidden elaboration checks.

requirements.statement: Reset is active-low and synchronous to the rising edge.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A reset edge clears occupancy and validity; a reset transition between edges has no asynchronous state effect.

requirements.statement: After reset the FIFO is empty, not full, has zero fill level, and has no valid output.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The four public status outputs match the reset-state values.

requirements.statement: An enqueue occurs exactly on an accepted input handshake.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only in_valid_i && in_ready_o may increase occupancy or append data.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed handshake matrix and queue-model comparison.

requirements.statement: A dequeue occurs exactly on an accepted output handshake.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only out_valid_o && out_ready_i may decrease occupancy or remove the head.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed handshake matrix and queue-model comparison.

requirements.statement: Accepted data is returned exactly once and in acceptance order.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The observed output sequence equals the accepted input sequence after accounting for unconsumed items.

requirements.statement: A stalled valid output remains stable.
requirements.acceptance_rule: out_valid_o and out_data_o do not change while out_valid_o && !out_ready_i, absent reset.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed backpressure test and stability assertion.

requirements.statement: Empty, full, and fill level exactly reflect occupancy.
requirements.acceptance_rule: empty_o iff count=0, full_o iff count=DEPTH, and fill_level_o=count.

requirements.statement: Simultaneous accepted enqueue and dequeue preserve occupancy and ordering.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The old head is returned and the new input is appended; fill level is unchanged.
requirements.verification_intent: Directed partially-full and full simultaneous-transfer tests.

requirements.statement: Overflow and underflow attempts have no state effect.
requirements.acceptance_rule: A nonaccepted request cannot change occupancy, stored ordering, or output validity.

requirements.statement: The FIFO is registered and non-fall-through.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Input accepted while empty cannot be consumed through a combinational same-cycle bypass.
requirements.verification_intent: Empty enqueue with output ready asserted.

requirements.statement: Legal non-power-of-two depths have full usable capacity and correct wraparound.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Depths 3, 5, and 7 accept exactly DEPTH words and preserve order across repeated wraps.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned parameter sweep and wraparound sequences.

requirements.statement: All DATA_WIDTH >= 1 and DEPTH >= 2 parameterizations are semantically supported.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Representative legal widths and depths elaborate and satisfy the same contract.
DATA_WIDTH < 1 or DEPTH < 2 must cause elaboration or an equivalent static failure.

requirements.statement: The submission stays inside the declared editable scope.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only rtl/golden12_fifo.sv is added or modified within the submission.

simultaneous_operation_table.note: Registered non-fall-through: the new item is visible after the edge.
Remove the old head and append the new input.
Full throughput is allowed when the dequeue is accepted.
Overflow attempt has no state effect.
Underflow attempt has no state effect.

excluded_claims: Development evaluator calibration does not convert a workflow run into a frozen benchmark PASS.
No baseline, performance, timing, area, power, or PPA result exists.
Independent alternative-implementation review, environment freeze, scoring freeze, and admission remain future gates.
